title: Intel stock jumps 12%+, hitting a new all-time high, on a report that Apple has had early-stage talks with Intel about enlisting Intel's chipmaking services (Lola Murti/CNBC)
summary: Lola Murti / CNBC: Intel stock jumps 12%+, hitting a new all-time high, on a report that Apple has had early-stage talks with Intel about enlisting Intel's chipmaking services — Intel shares climbed 14% Tuesday, hitting a new all-time high as the chipmaker continued its historic run from April.
